task_description: Implement topic embedding matching for the chat RAG pipeline. Topic embeddings are stored in MongoDB (not Vertex). At chat time, generate a query embedding via Vertex AI text-embedding-005, compare against stored topic embeddings using cosine similarity, and only proceed with RAG if a match >= 0.70 is found.

verification.summary: All 218 tests pass (including 13 new topic matcher tests). Imports verified. Review issues (token caching, stream parallelism, httpx reuse, cache lock, timeout, error TTL) all addressed.
